target.title: fix: keep session thinking through transcript recovery
target.body:
Closes #109275

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with stored `/think` or `/verbose` session preferences could lose those preferences when command-session resolution rotates the OpenClaw session id for terminal transcript-registry recovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps stored thinking and verbose preferences available when terminal transcript recovery creates a replacement session id but the configured daily/idle reset policy would otherwise still treat the session as current. It intentionally does not carry those preferences when terminal recovery overlaps a configured daily or idle reset boundary, so a configured clean-session reset still wins.

## User Impact

Users who set `/think high` or `/verbose full` keep that session preference through terminal transcript recovery instead of silently falling back to defaults. Operators who rely on daily or idle session resets still get a clean session without inherited thinking or verbose preferences.

## Evidence

Red/green regression proof:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/command/session.provider-owned-reset.test.ts

Before the fix:
FAIL carries stored thinking and verbose preferences during terminal transcript recovery
AssertionError: expected undefined to be 'high'

After the fix:
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       6 passed (6)
```

Additional local proof:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/agent/session.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       16 passed (16)

node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.cmd src/agents/command/session.ts src/agents/command/session.provider-owned-reset.test.ts
Finished in 985ms on 2 files

node_modules/.bin/oxlint.cmd src/agents/command/session.ts src/agents/command/session.provider-owned-reset.test.ts
git diff --check
```

I also attempted the closest current `agent-command` test file because the issue's original acceptance listed `src/agents/agent-command.test.ts`, which no longer exists on current main. `src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts` is blocked in this local environment before target assertions because Node 24.13.0 embeds SQLite 3.50.4, which OpenClaw rejects for WAL safety; CI should cover this on a supported Node runtime.


## Follow-up Proof After Review

After the latest ClawSweeper review, this branch was rebased onto upstream/main 5a0bb2a146d and the unrelated startup-memory threshold commit was removed from this PR. The diff is now limited to the session resolver and its regression tests.

Runtime recovery proof, using official portable Node v24.18.0 with SQLite 3.53.1, a temporary redacted OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR, the real session store writer, the real agent SQLite transcript writer, and the production resolveSession path:

```json
{
  "node": "v24.18.0",
  "sqlite": "3.53.1",
  "stateDir": "<redacted-temp-state>",
  "proofPath": "real session store + real agent SQLite transcript + resolveSession",
  "recovery": {
    "oldSessionId": "redacted-terminal-session-before",
    "newSessionIdChanged": true,
    "isNewSession": true,
    "persistedThinking": "high",
    "persistedVerbose": "full"
  },
  "dailyResetOverlap": {
    "oldSessionId": "redacted-terminal-session-daily-expired",
    "newSessionIdChanged": true,
    "isNewSession": true,
    "persistedThinking": null,
    "persistedVerbose": null
  }
}
```

Focused proof after removing the unrelated CI repair commit:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/command/session.provider-owned-reset.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       6 passed (6)

node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.cmd --check src/agents/command/session.ts src/agents/command/session.provider-owned-reset.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

git diff --check
```
